messages:
matie: quick flag 1: customers on dedicated infra report SSO failures during login -> 500 from auth-proxy. Saw SCIM deprovision events for same users minutes earlier.

jon: any KMS errors in logs? could be key policy preventing re-encryption during a migration.

matie: yes in auth-proxy logs: `KMS ReEncrypt: AccessDeniedException` around 2026-04-05T08:45Z. SCIM payloads show extId encrypted blob present but later requests show empty extid field.

security-bot: KMS alert: policy change for key alias "alias/dedicated-extid" (1717658000). Diff: removed sts:AssumeRole for `legacy-migrator`. Audit link: https://audit.redwood.internal/kms/1717658000 :warning:

ops-oncall: repro steps I used in staging:
```bash
# simulate legacy migrator rewrap fail
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.enc --destination-key-id alias/dedicated-extid --encryption-context '{"env":"prod","tenant":"t-42"}' \
  || echo "rewrap failed"
```
It fails when migrator role isn't allowed to call ReEncrypt. Service then writes null extid back to user record.

jon: root cause: migration job silently wrote null on failure. fix: 1) make migration job transactional (don't mutate DB on rewrap failure), 2) restore missing extids from backup for affected tenants, 3) revert overly broad KMS policy change but lock it down properly.

matie: short fix in prod: roll back policy change to allow legacy-migrator to ReEncrypt for a 30m window while we run canary rewrap for affected tenants. ops-oncall you good to run?

ops-oncall: will run canary. scheduling low-impact tenant t-42 first. I'll also add guard in migrator: write only after successful decrypt+encrypt. PR: https://stash.redwood.internal/p/migrator/+/987

security-bot: creating incident SEC-2026-057, assigned to @matie @ops-oncall @jon. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/SEC-2026-057 :rotating_light:
